cases.input: Every route family at 390 and 1440 under six scenarios set before navigation: (a) no saved choice + system light · (b) no saved choice + system dark · (c) saved 'light' + system dark · (d) saved 'dark' + system light · (e) hard reload after toggling · (f) system preference flipped at runtime (page.emulateMedia) with and without a saved choice; plus the served HTML of /
cases.expected_behavior: One theme system (S22/S25): <html data-theme='light|dark'> is set by an inline pre-paint script in <head> that runs before the first stylesheet; resolution order saved explicit choice → prefers-color-scheme → light; only an explicit toggle choice is persisted, under the localStorage key 'portfolio-theme' with the values light|dark (nothing is written on a plain visit); a saved choice survives a hard reload with no wrong-theme flash — the data-theme attribute takes exactly one value for the life of the document (a MutationObserver installed by addInitScript records its history); with no saved choice the page follows a runtime system change, with a saved choice it does not; 0 hydration warnings or console errors across every scenario
cases.expected_output: 6/6 scenarios resolve to the expected theme at both widths · data-theme history length 1 on every load · pre-paint script precedes the first <link rel=stylesheet> in the SSR HTML · localStorage untouched on a plain visit · 0 hydration warnings
failure_conditions: a wrong-theme first paint (data-theme history longer than 1, or the attribute set after first paint)
a saved choice losing to prefers-color-scheme
a plain visit writing portfolio-theme
a key other than portfolio-theme or a value other than light|dark
a runtime system change ignored when nothing is saved, or honoured when a choice is saved
any hydration warning or console error during load
the pre-paint script missing from <head> or placed after a stylesheet
cases.method: Playwright (tests/e2e/eval-023.spec.ts): context.addInitScript seeds localStorage and a MutationObserver on <html> before any page script; page.emulateMedia({ colorScheme }) sets the system preference; a console listener collects hydration messages; request.get('/') for the head-order check
cases.accessibility_requirement: A visitor's OS preference is honoured without any action; an explicit choice is remembered so nothing has to be redone per visit (dark-mode.md §48)
